item.title: Air Wisconsin Airlines sells assets to two companies for $110 million
item.description: Appleton-based Air Wisconsin Airlines has a new ownership group after the company’s assets were sold to two other entities. On Jan. 9, Harbor Diversified, Inc. sold the assets of Air Wisconsin via two separate transactions. Harbor Diversified is the holding company for Air Wisconsin Airlines. item.title: Children’s Wisconsin receives $10 million gift to support pediatric research
item.description: Children’s Wisconsin has received a $10 million gift from Milwaukee philanthropists Barri and Dave Drury.

item.title: Delafield man gets 18 months in prison following $2 million Medicare scheme
item.description: Former Kestral Medical co-owner Bruce Johnson has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for his role in a $2 million Medicare kickback scheme.

item.description: Two stalled apartment development projects in Milwaukee’s Walker’s Point neighborhood are moving ahead with support from two proposed tax incremental financing (TIF) districts. item.title: As sales grow, Johnson Controls works to support next generation of AI factories
item.description: Johnson Controls says rising data center and AI demand is driving growth for its thermal management business as the company expands capacity.

item.title: Home construction up significantly in Waukesha County in 2025, while Milwaukee and Racine counties had big declines
item.description: Waukesha County had one of the biggest increases for single family home construction starts in 2025, while Milwaukee County and Racine County had some of the most significant housing construction declines in the state. item.title: Former Catholic Charities employees, including a former COO, indicted following multi-million-dollar fraud scheme
item.description: Former Catholic Charities employees have been indicted on 15 federal charges, accused of defrauded the nonprofit of more than $2 million.
